name: chunker-restart
note: two strings of 150000 bytes, BLAKE3 extended output over 'P4 restart a' and over 'P4 restart b', and their concatenation: chunked as one string, a chunk spans the boundary, so the lengths of the concatenation are not those of a followed by those of b, and a writer that chunks each blob on its own restarts the cut at offset 0 of b (P4-12)
